bottom_line: Two clean equal-depth ~3.5 ppt transits (reference S34, E1 S61) on TIC 118339710, 723.995 d apart; the S88 event E2 is rejected (difference-image centroid 12.0 arcsec off at 14.7 sigma, POS_CORR2 -5.2 sigma). 26 data-allowed aliases of dT = 723.995 d (P >= 27.8 d by the review reading; shortest density-compatible 20.69 d per event). No <=4-sigma secondary at the covered aliases, no capable neighbour within the blend radius; RV untested — Unverified lead.

catalog_audit.ExoFOP note (from the run's TOI-8 row, 2: possible additional transit at TBJD 1525.648 — unrelated to the vetted epochs
catalog_audit.NASA Exoplanet Archive (pscomppars, 30 a: 2 prior planets on the host (TOI-6695 b, TOI-6695 c) — sibling-neighborhood checked through the host ephemerides in vet; neither predicts the lead epochs
catalog_audit.SIMBAD (30 arcsec): TOI-6695b (Pl); TOI-6695 (*); TOI-6695c (Pl) — no eclipsing-binary class

competing: Transiting planet (P one of 26 aliases, possibly ~ 20-724 d; depth 3.5 ppt on a 1.56 Rsun host => Rp ~ 3.9 R_Earth).
Long-period grazing EB: allowed by two events; secondary hiding in seasonal gaps possible; RV is decisive.
Blend: disfavoured — no capable neighbour within the blend radius, difference image on-target at E1, empty common mode.
Sibling-planet transit: excluded by the sibling ephemerides (none predicted at the lead epoch).

red_noise_significance_E1.value: 33.3 robust sigma below the 300-epoch random null

next_test: RV on the host (host 1.15 Msun): a planet at these P gives K ~ 20 m/s for a Saturn-mass companion; a stellar companion km/s. Ground photometry at the 26 alias phases and future TESS sectors against each alias ephemeris are the photometric path.
